doc_title: NOTICE OF OBJECTION TO REMOVAL OF A CAUTION
doc_title_official: NOTICE OF OBJECTION TO REMOVAL OF A CAUTION
when_used: A cautioner served with an application to remove a caution notifies the Land Registrar that the cautioner objects to its removal.

detail_rows.label: Date of Application to remove Caution
The Cautioner: Give full name(s) and if corporate the registration number, if any
The Proprietor/Interested Party: Give full name(s) and company’s registration number, if any

body_text.text: The Cautioner HEREBY NOTIFIES the Land Registrar of his/her/its objection to the removal of the Caution registered in Entry Number(s) {{entry_numbers}} on the Encumbrances Section of the Register.
IN WITNESS WHEREOF this notice of objection has been duly executed this........................…. day of…………..………….. 20……….

custom_fields.name: caution_date
custom_fields.label: Date of the Caution
custom_fields.prompt: The date of the caution objected to being removed

custom_fields.name: entry_numbers
custom_fields.label: Entry number of the Caution
custom_fields.prompt: The entry number or numbers of the caution in the Encumbrances Section of the register
